$comment: Allowlist for bare Chinese. Every entry must give a reason: only content that is inherently Chinese and must not be translated (user-data samples, language names, third-party content) is allowed. UI copy always goes into apps/web/src/i18n/locales/*, never here.

allow.reason: In the language switcher every language always shows itself in its native name (LOCALE_LABEL); that is the language name itself and is never translated.
